body.name: \(\Pi_G(\mathcal O_G),\Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
Define the published-class compatible-order set as the order projection
\[
 \Pi_G(\mathcal O_G)=
 \left\{\pi\in\mathfrak S_V:
 \exists(\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\pi)\in\mathfrak F_G(\mathcal O_G)
 \text{ with }\widetilde\pi=\pi\right\}.
\]
Define separately the component-aligned observable refinement
\[
 \Pi_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)=
 \left\{\pi\in\mathfrak S_V:
 \operatorname{offdiag}(R_\pi^{ab})=0\text{ for every }\{a,b\}\in E,
 \text{ and every }Q_{\pi,j}\text{ admits a completion in }
 \mathbb S_{++}^m\right\}.
\]
